task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to grab the mouse with scroll wheel and place on the angled black smooth displaystand.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用右臂抓住带有滚轮的鼠标并将其放置在有角度的黑色光滑展示架上。
